biography.heading: Border-crossing adaptability and an uncompromising eye for detail. Building products that solve problems from the ground up.
paragraphs: A solid foundation in Computer Science, studied systematically at a Canadian college where diverse cultures intersect, combined with the philosophy of "tenaciously refining the final product" forged as a professional chef in a multinational team. These two experiences form the bedrock of my engineering approach.

I am highly confident in my adaptability to dive into unknown environments and tackle complex technical challenges, making continuous self-improvement a daily habit through online courses like Udemy. In response to the rapidly accelerating development of AI technologies, I actively test and explore new generative AI tools in my personal time. This curiosity-driven learning directly translates to agile integration in practical applications, such as implementing the Gemini API.

In the fast-paced frontend domain, rather than simply chasing trends, I pursue the construction of systems that "maximize business value and user experience" while carefully evaluating architectural trade-offs.

timeline.title: Generative AI-Driven Multilingual Blog System Development
timeline.description: Developed a multilingual blog system from scratch based on Next.js (App Router). Implemented a mechanism to automatically generate multilingual articles from original content by integrating the Gemini API as the system's core, while adopting next-intl for UI localization. Continuously operated not merely as an information platform, but as a testing ground for modern technologies and performance tuning.
timeline.linkText: View architecture details and AI implementation on GitHub

timeline.title: Large-Scale Newspaper System Modernization
timeline.description: Waterfall development project migrating from a legacy system (Java/JSP) to a modern environment. In charge of frontend development. Analyzed existing Java code, visualized process flows using sequence diagrams, and drove the clarification of complex business specifications and the formulation of detailed designs. Additionally, contributed to the independence of junior members and elevated the overall development capabilities of the team by providing technical support and documentation assistance through pair programming as a mentor.

timeline.title: New E-commerce Site Development
timeline.description: New e-commerce site launch project. Solely responsible for everything from requirements definition to design, implementation, and operation. Given the relatively small backend scale, established a consistent architecture by utilizing Next.js (App Router) Route Handlers to encapsulate APIs. Adopted MongoDB for the database to flexibly respond to specification changes. Integrated a secure payment infrastructure using the Stripe API and automated transactional email delivery (order completion, inquiries) via Resend, achieving stable operation within a short timeframe.

timeline.title: Portfolio Creation Platform Development
timeline.description: Participated in a new launch project for a portfolio creation service targeting engineers and creators. Primarily responsible for the backend domain, centered on TypeScript, during the team development implementation phase. Focused on designing API routing using Express.js and implementing business logic (controller processing) for each endpoint call. Established the fundamentals of modern web development and team workflows in a practical setting by constructing a suite of APIs, including CRUD operations using MongoDB.

timeline.title: Systematic Study of Computer Science and Web Development
timeline.jobTitle: Cornerstone International Community College of Canada (Vancouver, Canada)
timeline.description: Systematically studied everything from fundamental CS theories to algorithms and data structures in an English-speaking environment. Comprehensively mastered modern web development technologies—from frontend (React, Next.js) to backend (Express.js, MySQL, MongoDB)—through a practical curriculum centered on JavaScript/TypeScript. Acquired the ability to drive development projects forward by communicating logically across language and cultural barriers through group work with multinational peers.

timeline.title: Chef
timeline.description: Worked concurrently with my college studies. Accumulated experience in refining a single product while collaborating with a multinational team in a high-pressure, cross-cultural kitchen environment. The time management and communication skills forged in this demanding setting, along with an uncompromising dedication to detail and quality, serve as the firm foundation for my professional values today.
